answer: Make rewards illiquid before they are trusted. Every coin an agent earns drips out of a locked vesting vault over 100 epochs, never all at once, and across that whole horizon any later jury that rules the account a sybil claws back and burns the unreleased balance, so standing stays as brittle as unset jade until the window clears. A farm of 1000 clones cannot cash out and vanish: each clone needs its own vault frozen for ~100 epochs and each is independently slashable, so the attacker capital is held hostage against every future fraud verdict instead of extracted on day one.
